articles.title: A Library Card and an Empty Chair
articles.titleZh: 一张借书卡与一把空椅子
articles.sourceQuote: Sharing a space required attention to other people's needs as well as one's own.

content.meaningZh: ……需要……，也需要……；用来说明应同时兼顾的两方面。
content.structure: 主语 + require(s) + 名词短语 + as well as + 名词短语。本句中attention to作用于两组需求，one’s own省略了needs。
content.exampleEn: Sharing a space required attention to other people's needs as well as one's own.
content.exampleZh: 共享一个空间，需要关注他人的需求，也要顾及自己的需求。

articles.title: The Note That Helped the Next Shift
articles.titleZh: 帮助下一班同事的一份记录
articles.sourceQuote: They made conversations more specific and reduced repeated searches for basic information.

content.meaningZh: ……使……更加……，并减少……；用于说明一项做法带来的两种效果。
keyPhrases: make conversations more specific：使交流更具体
reduce repeated searches：减少重复查找
content.structure: 主语 + make + 宾语 + more + 形容词 + and + reduce + 宾语。两个动词共用主语；原文用made/reduced表示过去发生的效果。
content.exampleEn: They made conversations more specific and reduced repeated searches for basic information.
content.exampleZh: 这些记录让交流更加具体，也减少了对基本信息的重复查找。

articles.title: A Meeting with Time to Think
articles.sourceQuote: It also depended on how people received information, prepared a response, and understood what would happen next.
articles.exampleType: 依据原句改写的编辑例句（非原文逐字引用）

content.meaningZh: ……取决于人们如何……；可用于解释一个结果受到哪些过程因素影响。
keyPhrases: what will happen next：接下来会发生什么
content.structure: 主语 + depend(s) on + how引导的宾语从句。how从句可包含共用主语的多个并列谓语，分别说明影响结果的因素。
content.exampleEn: Effective participation depends on how people receive information, prepare a response, and understand what will happen next.
content.exampleZh: 有效参与取决于人们如何获取信息、准备回应，以及了解接下来的安排。
scenarios: 分析影响参与度的因素
